history.summary: A 2007 99LH 1BR at Domain 21 (D03 Alexandra) for $1.088M / $1,943 psf, with a solid 5.32%/yr URA resale CAGR (28 txns) and PSF ~5% BELOW the $2,045 district median. Strong RCR location and Greater Southern Waterfront optionality make this a reasonable city-fringe 1BR, tempered by lease age and the niche unit type.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely positive signals: 5.32%/yr resale appreciation over a usable 28-txn base, and PSF $1,943 sits ~5% under the median $2,045 (priced below recent transactions). D03 Alexandra/Redhill is a strong RCR micro-market with GSW and TEL/EWL access. Holding it back: a 2007 lease (~80yr left), 1BR niche exit, and an 860m MRT walk. The value and location lift it toward the top of Neutral but not to a clear Buy at a 1BR quantum.
